# Gemini Code Assist

> Gemini Code Assist is Google's AI-powered coding assistant that provides intelligent code completion, IDE integration, and enterprise features for individual developers and teams.

Gemini Code Assist leverages advanced AI models (Gemini 2.5, Gemini 3) and integrates with popular development environments like Visual Studio Code and JetBrains IDEs. It supports GitHub integration, Firebase integration, and includes enterprise-grade features like code review automation and agent mode for team collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Gemini Code Assist
- AI coding assistant
- Code completion
- IDE integration
- Gemini 3 model
- Gemini 2.5
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Human in the Loop (HiTL)
- GitHub integration
- Firebase integration
- Visual Studio Code
- JetBrains IntelliJ
- Enterprise features
- Agent mode
- Team development
